description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Greater Fort Lauderdale market through PTF-FORT-LAUDERDALE-FL-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-002. Every number is derived from THIS market's committed authority by release_contracts.derive_authority; none is typed and none is inherited from or comparable to another market's contract.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and asserts nothing about the market being complete -- 323 of this market's 461 registered identities are still unresolved, and no founder deployment decision exists for Fort Lauderdale at 85 published profiles.

identity_census.note: 461 registered identities, built from zero by PTF-FORT-LAUDERDALE-FL-HARDENED-SOURCE-READY-001 on the Miami-live release-factory lineage and closed in that same order through the supported attended-browser lane (90 paced attempts, 81 first-party brand reads, no paid provider and no Akamai bypass), registered by PTF-FORT-LAUDERDALE-FL-REGISTRATION-AND-STAGING-002. Membership is this market's own corridor postal partition (census_membership_basis CORRIDOR_REGISTRY): 18 corridors over 53 Broward County postal codes. Miami-Dade belongs to the LIVE miami-fl market and Palm Beach County and the Florida Keys are named, refused and preserved for their own future markets. Broward's postal codes straddle municipalities, so a corridor covers a shared code WHOLE and reports its towns as overlays; Port Everglades IS a corridor because ZIP 33316 carries hotels no other corridor claims, and FLL is NOT because the airport owns no postal code. Individual vacation houses, condo units, rental-management portfolios and timeshare inventory are never admitted. Rows the identity graph did not admit are recorded, not dropped: 3 DUPLICATE_LISTING; 148 IDENTITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED; 598 NAME_ONLY_UNRESOLVED; 249 NON_LODGING; 1087 OUTSIDE_MARKET; 12 SAME_CAMPUS_DISTINCT_ENTITY.

reconciliation.note: 85 clean pet-friendly and 53 clean verified-no-pets over a 461-identity census. A row publishes only on an OPERATIVE first-party quote from the property's own page, bound to its census identity by the property code or the full street identity that page states: a fee, a weight, a count, an amenity chip or a service-animal sentence alone publishes nothing, one brand page that binds two census rows publishes for neither, and an identity the census cannot address never publishes. 323 identities did not publish (89 ACCESS_BLOCKED; 37 EVIDENCE_HOLD; 38 IDENTITY_MISMATCH_HOLD; 90 ROUTING_HOLD; 69 SOURCE_SILENT); every one is named in fort_lauderdale_fl_clean_authority_001.json with its class. No gate was lowered to preserve a count.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Every record carries the exact operator quote for each published fact, the capture lane, and the sha256 of the document it was read from.

final_partition.note: The partition of record for this market, referenced by path and content digest so the whole-site assembler resolves it from THIS contract rather than from a table in its own source. Written from the committed file by release_contracts.final_partition_block; verified by market_partition_resolution: the file must exist, declare this market_id, hash to expected_sha256 and carry expected_count identities. Regenerating the partition means reissuing this block.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package (not-published seed hotels: held/manual-review plus rows still pending evidence) must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing/category page, nearby-lodging cards on any page, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links, and /go/ interstitials. This market currently holds none -- every seed row it owns is published -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/fort-lauderdale-fl/. 10 of 18 corridors reach their own publication minimum; the rest are suppressed, which is a threshold and not a gap. The market and its corridors are hidden from navigation and the sitemap (show_in_navigation=false, show_in_sitemap=false) until a launch order says otherwise.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
